name: Boryszew S.A.
summary: Boryszew S.A. engages in the metals, automotive and chemical industries in Poland and internationally. The company operates through Metals, Automotive, Circular Economy, Chemicals, Energy, and Others segments. The company offers automotive fluid transport systems, including air conditioning and high-pressure rubber hoses, and external and internal plastic automotive parts, including galvanized, large- scale, and moving parts.
